PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Write /ig <prompt> on an LCD to show a generated image there
PluginData.Description:
Write /ig followed by a prompt as the text of an LCD or any other screen, or look at a screen and send it in chat. An image model draws the picture onto that screen in color characters.
Works offline and when hosting a friends game. Players who join need no plugin.
Needs the MOSS-Image model running in a stable-diffusion.cpp sd-server, on this PC or another one with a 16 GB GPU. Setup: https://github.com/viktor-ferenczi/se-image-gen/blob/main/Docs/image-server.md
Report bugs on GitHub: https://github.com/viktor-ferenczi/se-image-gen/issues
